name: Arlberghöhe
beschreibung: The Arlberghöhe is a hotel in Sankt Anton am Arlberg, Tirol. It is located in the center of the village, in close proximity to the lifts. The hotel offers various room and suite categories. Amenities include a wellness area, restaurants, and a bar. The accommodation is a starting point for skiing and hiking activities in the region. Sankt Anton is known for its ski area and summer hiking trails. The hotel offers a concierge service and storage facilities for sports equipment. Parking spaces are available in the underground garage.
